issues.issue: Should the Court decide the merits of the sponsorship-delay application, which had become moot?
issues.applicant_position: Only costs remain in issue; he does not press the merits of the processing order.
issues.result_quote: the Court declines to exercise its discretion to decide the matter on the merits

issues.issue: Were there special reasons under Rule 22 to award costs against the Respondent for the processing delay?
issues.applicant_position: Unreasonable delay in processing justifies special costs; the Court should send a message to the Minister.
issues.respondent_position: Delay was longer than the norm but there was no bad faith; reasons were explained and circumstances justified it.
issues.result_quote: Accordingly, I find that there are no special reasons to award costs against the Respondent.
